title: CULTURAL FIDELITY IN LARGE-LANGUAGE MODELS: AN EVALUATION OF ONLINE LANGUAGE RESOURCES AS A DRIVER OF MODEL PERFORMANCE IN VALUE REPRESENTATION
reasoning: The paper benchmarks Large Language Models using the World Values Survey (WVS), which contains specific categories for 'Religious Values' and 'Ethical values and norms'. The evaluation include specific questions (detailed in Appendix D) about religious conflict, moral boundaries (e.g., stealing, bribery), and ethical issues (e.g., abortion, euthanasia, suicide).
